value: .Care Plan - Care of the Geriatric Patient
If in place, restraints / seclusion will be discontinued at earliest possible time
Patient will be protected from fall-related injuries
Patient will not be at risk for pulling at tubes, lines, catheters, drains
Call light within patient's reach at all times
Frequent patient checks and clear, firm limit setting
Identify patient as high fall risk to all personnel
Identify triggers for initiation of restraints / seclusion
Inform patient / family of reason for restraints / seclusion and criteria for release
Obtain M.D. order for nonviolent restraints daily, document every 2 hour restraints assessment
Provide relief of pain / discomfort as indicated and ordered
Safe use of restraints only when less restrictive measures have proved inadequate
Patient will be safe and free from injury during hospitalization and at time of discharge
Patient will detox from substance safely and without serious discomfort from withdrawal
Patient will express awareness of the substance abuse problem and its impact on their life
Patient will identify and practice alternative coping strategies (e.g. accept referral to treatment center, etc)
Activate drug and alcohol withdrawal guidelines as indicated
Explain purpose and goal of monitoring and treatment
Institute all necessary precautions (restraints w/ order, side rails, level of disorientation, symptoms of withdrawal)
Obtain drug history/document substance used, time/amt of last ingestion, length/freq of consumption, amt consumed per day
Provide resources for substance abuse / nicotine treatment after discharge
Provide support, encouragement, and / or counseling to patient / family
Vital signs and CIWA / COWS (CINA) as indicated per protocol
